revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, later converted into a transparent 768x768 local candidate asset
Asset name: achievement_medal_steps_tier_004
Primary request: Create one premium collectible steps achievement medal for tier 4, GREEN rank, based on the Chinese title concept "要啥自行车" (who needs a bicycle when feet can do it). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal. Inside the circle is the same funny anthropomorphic foot mascot design from the white tiers: soft foot-shaped body, five toes on top like a goofy crown/hair tuft, tiny cartoon arms and tiny legs, expressive face. Tier 4 pose: proudly stepping over or balancing beside a tiny bicycle wheel and pedal fragment, looking smug as if feet are better than a bike. The bicycle fragment must have no text, no brand, no realistic full bike crowding the mascot.
Medal border: GREEN rank. Circular emerald / mint green enamel border with silver accents, simple side buckles and small leaf-like green ornaments, slightly more decorative than white tier 3 but still early green rank. No blue, purple, orange, or gold rank border.
Style/medium: same premium mobile game collectible style as the new TripPet travel medals: polished 3D-like enamel and metal, glossy highlights, cute humorous center character, crisp small-UI readability, not watercolor paper.
Composition/framing: exactly one centered medal, full object visible, generous padding, square composition, central mascot fully inside circular core. Base circle size consistent with previous tiers.
Lighting/mood: bright soft studio highlights, confident and funny.
Color palette: emerald/mint green border, silver trim, warm cream foot mascot, soft blush, muted gray bicycle wheel/pedal; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals, no shield shape, no dark UI card.
rank_color_rule: 001-003 white, 004-006 green; future 007-008 blue, 009-010 purple, 011-012 orange, 013-014 gold
transparent_background_method: built-in image_gen on #ff00ff chroma key, remove_chroma_key.py auto-key soft matte despill, resize to 768x768
